LESSON: PRESENTATION SKILLS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: SPEAKING
Topic 2.5: Presentation skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Presentation skills. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use appropriate tonal variation, articulation and stress to express self confidently
2. appreciate the use of transition words to sequence events activities Core-Competence to be developed: Communication/Collaboration: learners make presentations before their peers Critical thinking and problem solving: learners sequence events and organize their presentations Self-efficacy: confidence in expressing self

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use appropriate tonal variation, articulation and stress to express self confidently
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use appropriate tonal variation, articulation and stress to express self confidently. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the use of transition words to sequence events activities Core-Competence to be developed: Communication/Collaboration: learners make presentations before their peers Critical thinking and problem solving: learners sequence events and organize their presentations Self-efficacy: confidence in expressing self
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the use of transition words to sequence events activities Core-Competence to be developed: Communication/Collaboration: learners make presentations before their peers Critical thinking and problem solving: learners sequence events and organize their presentations Self-efficacy: confidence in expressing self. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Presentation skills using something you see at school.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Presentation skills.
2. Explain Presentation skills to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Presentation skills.
4. Show that you can: use appropriate tonal variation, articulation and stress to express self confidently
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Presentation skills. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Presentation skills important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. use appropriate tonal variation, articulation and stress to express self confidently
2. appreciate the use of transition words to sequence events activities Core-Competence to be developed: Communication/Collaboration: learners make presentations before their peers Critical thinking and problem solving: learners sequence events and organize their presentations Self-efficacy: confidence in expressing self

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
